channels.name: cd_associator
channels.what_it_measures: full 16D CD cubic mismatch on six samples

channels.name: max_rotation
channels.what_it_measures: max stepwise angle of B in the same six samples

channels.name: mag_jump
channels.what_it_measures: max |B| minus min |B| in the same six samples

channels.name: cd_magnitude_zeroed
channels.what_it_measures: CD associator after clearing every |B| channel

channels.name: cd_e8_zeroed
channels.what_it_measures: CD associator after clearing lag-2 Bx (doubling slot)

channels.name: cd_quaternion_lag0
channels.what_it_measures: CD associator on lag-0 only; algebraically associative, expect chance

channels.name: cd_octonion_two_lag
channels.what_it_measures: CD associator on lags 0-1 (octonion prefix e0..e7)

reading: lag-0 quaternion AUC 0.5000 is chance, so CD ranking is lag-mixing. two-lag octonion prefix 0.8264 vs full CD 0.8274. e8-zeroed 0.8270 matches CD, so lag-2 Bx is not the carrier. |B|-zeroed 0.8297 is at least CD, so the magnitude channel is not helping. max_rotation 0.8383 beats CD. mag_jump 0.7377 is a weaker compression channel.
